title: Synthesis of imidazopyridines via NaIO4/TBHP-promoted (3 + 2) cycloaddition and biological evaluation as anticancer agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15497-15504
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01949D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huiping Luo, Zhengyu Hu, Jihai Shi, Yongxin Lou, Zhonghua Shi, Xin Jin, Jia Chen, Xing Liu, Qiang Huang
A novel NaIO4/TBHP-promoted (3 + 2) cycloaddition was discovered for the synthesis of imidazopyridines. These synthesized compounds were evaluated for their antiproliferation for MOLM-13 and MV4-11 cells.
